title: Why are there no flow batteries with symmetric ferrocyanide electrolytes?
summary: The article explores why symmetric ferrocyanide electrolytes haven't been adopted in flow batteries, examining the electrochemical challenges and practical barriers that prevent this seemingly promising approach from working effectively.
problem_solved: Explains the technical barriers preventing symmetric ferrocyanide electrolytes from being viable for commercial flow battery applications.
why_valuable: Provides scientific insight into a niche but important area of energy storage technology, helping researchers and engineers understand fundamental limitations in battery chemistry.
